title: How to Tune Your Guitar for Beginners: Clip-on Tuners (PolyTune and Snark) and Basic Techniques
summary: JustinGuitar’s beginner tuning lesson guides new players through practical tuning using clip-on tuners, comparing a high-end PolyTune with a common Snark unit, and demonstrating a string-by-string tuning routine. The video covers how to tune up to each note, why tuning up (not down) is recommended, muting between strings with a rest-stroke thumb, and how neck movement after changing string tension can require a second pass. It also acknowledges scenarios where tuning by ear is useful when strings are very out of tune, and points to alternative tuning methods and additional resources on his site.
